Question: The graph of \(2x^2 + xy + 3y^2\) \(- 11x - 20y + 40 = 0\) is an ellipse in the first quadrant of the \(xy\)-plane. Let \(a\) and \(b\) be the maximum and minimum values of \(\dfrac{y}{x}\) over all points \((x, y)\) on the ellipse. What is the value of \(a + b?\)
